content: Paulo Korinto Yɔ
Ɩ́nɩ ɔma a, Paulo lɔ́kʋsʋ́ tsú Atene yɔ́ Korinto wúlutɔ.

Ɔlɔyɔ́tʋ Yudayin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Akwila, bɔkwɩɩ́ mʋ Italia ɔmanti kʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ́ Pontotɔ. Akwila mʋa mʋ ka Priskila bɛba Korinto ɩnʋ mɔkʋ́wá ɔpá. Tsúfɛ́ alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Roma Owíe Klaudio lagya Yudafɔ fɛ́ɛ́ lɛ́ Roma wúlutɔ. Paulo lɔ́yɔ amʋ́ wá.
Tati-obubí abwɛpʋ́ amʋ́ ɛ́ bʋgyi. Mʋ́ sʋ Paulo létsiá amʋ́ wá, mʋa mʋnyɔ betsiá bwɛ́ tati-obubí ámʋ fɛ́.
Ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ ɔdakɛ́ kugyíkʋ á, Paulo tɔyɔ́ Yudafɔ ofíakpa yɛ́lɛ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ wankláán súná Yudafɔ pʋ́ Griikifɔ ámʋ, mɛ́nɩ bɔ́hɔ Yesu gyi.

Brɛ́á Silas mʋa Timoteo botsu Makedonia bɔtʋ Paulo a, olesi agyʋ́má ámʋ yɔ, pʋ́ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkanda kóún bwɛ́ mʋ gyumagyihɛ. Oletsiá gyi adánsɩɛ súná Yudafɔ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, Yesu gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) nɩ.

Támɛ bʋmɔhɔ mʋ asʋ́n ámʋ. Bɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mʋsʋ, síá mʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ Paulo lɔ́fwɩ ɩbɩ lɛ́ amʋ́ asʋ́ntɔ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsú ndɛ pʋ́ya a, nalɛ́ ɩbɩ mlɩ asʋ́ntɔ́. Nɩ́ lowu mlɩdéklé a, ɩbá mlɩsʋ. Nɛ́yɛ́bláa ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ mboún Bulu asʋ́n.”
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ Paulo lɛ́dalɩ Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɩnʋ yétsiá oyin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Tito Yustus wóyítɔ́. Megyí Yudayin oyin ámʋ gyí, támɛ ogyi Bulu osúmpʋ́. Mʋ wóyí ɩbʋ mantáa Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɩnʋ.
Támɛ Krispu ánɩ́ ogyi Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɩnʋ ɔhandɛ mʋa mʋ wóyítɔ́fɔ fɛ́ɛ́ mʋ́ bɔhɔ anɩ Wíe Yesu gyi. Korintofɔ ámʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ ɛ́ bohogyi, bɔ́bɔ amʋ́ asú.
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ onyé á, Paulo lówun atɔ́. Mʋ́tɔ́ á, anɩ Wíe lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mánya ifú. Yɔ mʋ́sʋ́ afʋda asʋ́n ámʋ ɔkan wʋlɛ. Mákpa ɔnɔ́ bun.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́a fʋnyɔ ná. Ɔhaa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ bwɛ́ fʋ́ tɔtɔ. Mɩ́ ahá bʋtsɔ wúlu anfɩtɔ.”
Mʋ́ sʋ Paulo létsiá Korinto ɩnʋ súná ahá ámʋ Bulu asʋ́n ofi ɔkʋlɛ mʋ́a ɩfʋn.
Brɛ́á Galio létsiá Roma owíe otsiákpá, ɔdɛ Griikifɔ ɔsaasɩ́ ɔmanti kʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ́ Akaiasʋ kɩ́ɩ a, Yudafɔ ámʋ bɔbwɛ ɔnɔ-ɔkʋlɛ, kɩ́tá Paulo, pʋ́ mʋ ya mʋ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Bɛɛ, “Oyin ánfɩ dɛ́ ahá asʋkpan suná ɔbɛ́ɛ bʋsúm Bulu tsʋn ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɩlɔkʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ anɩ mblasʋsʋ.”
Paulo lénya bwíí ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ amʋtɔɩ alɩ Galio lɛ́bláa Yudafɔ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ tsitsa ntɛ́ɛ lakpan kʋ oyin ánfɩ labwɛ́ á, tɛkɩ ɩbʋ alɛ́á nɛ́yaa asʋ nú mlɩ asʋ́n.
Támɛ ɩ́nɩá adá pʋ́ mlɩ onutó mbla ɩwɩ asʋ́n ɩwɩ nwɛ́ɛn mlɩdégyí sʋ á, mlɩyɔ amlɩyɛblɩ́ mʋ́. Mméegyi asʋ́n ánfɩ odu.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛha begya amʋ́ lɛ́ asʋ́n ogyíkpá ɩnʋ á.
Ahá ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bowunáa kɩ́tá Sostene ánɩ́ ogyi Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɩnʋ ɔhandɛ, dá mʋ ɩnʋ. Támɛ Galio mótsu kʋkʋ lɛ́ mʋ́tɔ́.
Paulo Yinkí Yɔ́ Antiokia

Paulo létsiá ahógyipʋ amʋ wá Korinto yɔ́fʋn brɛ́ kʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛklá amʋ́, mʋa Priskila pʋ́ Akwila bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ Kenkrea wúlutɔ. Paulo lɛ́kpa mʋ nwun Kenkrea ɩnʋ, pʋ́súná ánɩ́ alamɔ́ ntam kʋá ɔlɛka ɔnɔ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ botsu ntsusʋ-yibi pʋ́ bɔyɔ́ Siria ɔmátɔ́ á.
Brɛ́á bowie Efeso wúlutɔ á, Paulo lɛ́natɩ́ sí Priskila mʋa Akwila, yɔ́ Yudafɔ ofíakpa, mʋa Yudafɔ ámʋ bʋdɛ asʋ́ntɔ́ lɛ há aba.
Bokokóli mʋ bɛɛ, ɔtráa tsia amʋ́ wá kpalobí, omotsulá.
Támɛ brɛ́á ɔdɛdalɩ ɔyɔ́ á, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ Bulu lótsulá á, néyinkí ba mlɩ wá.” Ɩnʋ olowie ntsusʋ-yibitɔ tsú Efeso ɩnʋ nátɩ́.
Brɛ́á ɔlɛkplɩ́ Kaesarea a, ɔlɔdʋ yɔ́ Yerusalem yɛ́ha ɔpasua ámʋ tsiá. Mʋ́ʋ́ oleyinkí kplɩ́ yɔ́ Antiokia a.
Oletsiá Antiokia ɩnʋ kpalobí. Mʋ́ ɔma a, ɔlɛnatɩ́ ɩnʋ beki Galatia pʋ́ Frigia ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ, ɔdɛ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ Bulu asʋ́n bláa, pʋ́wá amʋ́ ɔwʋnlɩ́n.
Apolo Bulu Asʋ́n Ɔkanda Efeso Mʋ́a Korinto
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Yudayin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Apolo laba ɔbʋ Efeso wúlutɔ. Bɔkwɩɩ́ mʋ Aleksandria, wúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Egyipte ɔmátɔ́. Oyin tɔɩ́, oyin Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɛ́ wankláán.
Bosuná mʋ anɩ Wíe ɔkpa ámʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ Yesu ɩwɩ ɔnɔkwalɩ amʋ blɩ́ tɛhɩ́ɛ́ wá mʋ ansigyí. Támɛ Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane asúbɔ ámʋ pɛ́ oyin.

Apolo ménya ifú. Ɔlɔwa klʋn súná atɔ́ Yudafɔ ofíakpa ɩnʋ wankláán. Brɛ́á Priskila mʋa Akwila bonu mʋ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ a, bɛkpa mʋ yáa wóyítɔ́ yósuná mʋ Bulu ɔkpa ámʋ wankláán dʋn alɩá oyin yaɩ́.

Brɛ́á Apolo lɔ́bwɛ agywɩɩn ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɔbɔ́yɔ Akaia ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ á, ahógyipʋ amʋ bɔwa mʋ atɛtɔ-ɔnlɩn. Bɔwanlɩ́n ɔwʋlʋ́ sɩ́sɩ́ ɩnʋ ahógyipʋ bɛɛ, bʋhɔ́ɔ mʋ wankláán. Brɛ́á oloyówie ɩnʋ á, ɔlɛhɩɛ bʋ́a ahá ánɩ́ ɩna Bulu awɩtɔlɛsʋ bahɔ Yesu gyi.

Apolo mʋa Yudafɔ ámʋ begyi Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɩwɩ nwɛ́ɛn, ɔlɔtɔɩ́ lɛ́ asʋ́ntɔ́ túmisʋ pʋ́gyi amʋ́sʋ́. Ɔlɔpʋ Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ súná amʋ́ ánɩ́ Yesu gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ).
